Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Renown 15+ with House Kundarak
Space: Cramped
Hirelings: 1
Order: Trade

An extradimensional vault occupying space in your Bastion like any special facility, offering exceptionally secure storage for your trade goods and treasures. Only you and your hirelings can open its door.

Kundarak Access. You (and only you) can reach the vault's contents from any Kundarak bank, found in cities across Khorvaire and in Stormreach, in Xen'drik.

Trade: Goods. For 7 days, the hireling either buys nonmagical items worth up to 2,000 GP in total (5,000 GP at level 13) and stores them in the vault, or sells goods stored there. You pay for purchases. When you sell goods from the vault, the buyer pays 20 percent more than the standard price (50 percent at level 13, 100 percent at level 17).

Source: Eberron: Forge of the Artificer.
